articleTitle: Arithmetic optimization algorithm to optimize support vector machine for chip defect Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: With the rapid development of chip technology today, manual detection of chip surface defects has fallen behind and machine vision inspection has become the mainstream method. In this paper, an arithmetic optimization algorithm is proposed to optimize the support vector machine to identify and classify several types of defects on the chip surface. First, the working principle of arithmetic optimization algorithm and support vector machine are studied. Then, the arithmetic optimization algorithm is used to find the optimal kernel function parameters and penalty factors for the support vector machine. At last, the sample set containing 8 types of defects is divided into training set and test set in the ratio of 3:1. The optimal parameters are used in support vector machine and the classification recognition rate is better than the manual selection of support vector machine parameter.

articleTitle: Implementation and research on indoor mobile robot mapping and navigation based on RTAB-Map
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The positioning, mapping and navigation of mobile robots has always been a hot topic which attracts widespread attention around the world. In this paper, mapping and navigating in a complex indoor environment of 100 square meters is done with the RTAB-Map algorithm for multi-sensor information fusion using an RGB-D camera, a single-line lidar, a gyroscope, an odometers and other sensors. Navigation tasks will be published after the map construction tasks is done, the experimental results are scored based on expressions of different approach. This study compares the scene data collected with the data in the real environment, analyzes the accuracy and error of the map with different methods. This study also compares the visual-laser combined mapping and navigation scheme with the pure vision schemes or pure laser schemes. Result shows that the task completion is 100% with the visual and lidar combined, compared with the scheme that uses lidar only (45%) or the RGB-D camera only (75%).

articleTitle: Multimodal Physiological Assessment of the Task-related Attentional States in a VR Driving Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The wandering mind is a significant source of distraction for drivers. There is extensive research studying the wandering mind via driving simulations, on-road driving, and surveys. This research project involved experience sampling in a Unity3D driving simulation environment and physiological sensors including eye tracking, EEG, respiration, temperature, skin conductance, blood volume pulse, and EMG to understand changes in drivers' physiological states that co-occur with mind wandering. The team conducted 33 experimental trials to collect and analyze data to set the stage for further research investigating the relationship between physiological representations and mind wandering. These results will provide guidance for further research in the problem space and potentially impact human factors design of automobiles.

articleTitle: Lower limb-assisted exoskeleton to support walking up and down stairs
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: In order to help the elderly and patients with lower limb diseases to complete the movement of walking up and down stairs, this paper designed a flexible lower limb power-assisted exoskeleton based on the characteristics of the lasso transmission and the tandem elastic actuator, which provides stage assistance to help the wearer to complete the daily movement of walking up and down stairs with less effort. Based on Angular and torque curves of each joint of the lower limb, the motion of each joint was analyzed and compared during walking up and down stairs and on the flat ground, so as to arrive at the reason why the elderly people struggle to walk up and down stairs, and according to this, the design requirements and overall scheme of the exoskeleton were provided. According to the overall scheme, the exoskeleton was divided into knee component, ankle component and backpack component, and the detailed structural design of the three components was carried out. The hardware and software system of the exoskeleton was designed to complete the acquisition of sensor data and the motion control of the exoskeleton, and to pre-process the gait data for gait recognition. Finally, the assist strategy of the assisted exoskeleton was determined and the experiment was conducted.

articleTitle: New Concept and Challenges for a Next-Generation Chewing Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Food texture analysis, bolus preparation and interaction between food and mastication system during chewing process through in vitro experiments are research hotspots in the field of food science and dental research. Several chewing robots have been developed for different applications, but they can only reproduce part of the oral function. Inspired by internal combustion engine, this research aims to present the concept and challenges of developing the next generation chewing robot with a set of chambers and chewing trajectories to prepare bolus for further research. For this new crankshaft-based chewing robot, a set of chewing trajectories can be generated simultaneously with only one motor. A V-shaped food repositioning mechanism is considered to achieve the automatic food repositioning without extra actuators.

articleTitle: Cognitive Evaluation of Digital Twin Interface Layout of Industrial Machine Tools Based on Aesthetics Model
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: With the increasing acceptance of the concept of digital twin, the interaction interface of traditional industrial machine tools is messy and complex. In the aspect of production line optimization for digital twin, the aesthetic feeling of the digital twin interface of machine tools is worth discussing. In this paper, the aesthetic evaluation of the layout of nine information blocks in the digital twin interface of a machine tool is completed by using six common comprehensive aesthetic indicators of computer interface (13 interface aesthetic standards proposed by Ngo). Taking eight different layouts as examples, and conducting comprehensive aesthetic evaluation and ranking, a simple performance experiment was completed to verify the fuzzy impact of interface aesthetics on cognitive performance. The ranking of the interface layout with the last ranking is improved after optimization by the above methods, which proves the effectiveness of the above methods.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Yoshimura Continuum Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Origami has been applied in robotic design thanks to its lightweight structures and versatile applications. In this paper, we propose and analyze a novel cable-driven Yoshimura continuum actuator. The origami module inspired by the Yoshimura pattern can bend and contract under the actuation of the cable. In addition, we analyze the kinematics of the Yoshimura continuum actuator using the assumption of constant curvature. Based on the kinematic model, a scheme of closed-loop control is designed and validated using the motion capture system. The results show that the kinematic model can predict the tip position of the actuator with the error of 2.14 mm and 3.51mm when following a spiral and a square trajectory. The Yoshimura continuum actuator can track spiral and square trajectories with an error of 1.92 mm and 2.93 mm by the aid of the control method, demonstrating reductions of 10.3% and 16.5% for the average tracking errors. It demonstrates the Yoshimura continuum actuator has the potential to achieve versatile movement.

articleTitle: The Wheel-legged Robot for Guanular Terrain: Guardian
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Wheeled robots have been wildly used in challenging terrain exploration due to their stability, simplicity, and flexibility. In this paper, a novel wheel-legged series robot is designed to achieve autonomous locomotion in various fields. The four-wheel-legged robot, Guardian, is implemented with a unique mechanical structure to ensure the ability of moving in granular terrain. It has four legs which are designed by connecting rods, and each leg has four degrees of freedom. Experiments are carried out to evaluate performance of the robot in various scenarios, including planar omni-directional motion, climbing over obstacles, and moving in granular media. By measuring traction force of the robot with different gait, the superiority of the robot in granular media movement has been showed.

articleTitle: Recognition of micro force locking contact state based on one-dimensional residual network
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The robot locking alignment has the characteristics of small tolerance, micro contact force, and high similarity of contact force. Meanwhile, due to the uncertainty of vision and robot system, it is a challenging problem to accurately identify the locking contact state of the robot. Limited by the number of contact state samples, the neural network based method performs poorly in contact state modeling. To solve this problem, a locking contact state recognition method based on the one-dimensional residual network is proposed. The process of this method is as follows: (1) Through linear interpolation within the class, virtual training contact force samples are randomly generated, and the sample distribution space is expanded, which effectively solves the over-fitting problem caused by fewer training samples. (2) The generated virtual samples and the real training samples are trained together to train the one-dimensional residual network, and the contact state recognition model is obtained. The precision locking screw alignment experiment is carried out in the experimental environment to further verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The experimental results show the effectiveness and potential of the method, the accuracy of the contact model reaches 99% and significantly solves the overfitting problem.

articleTitle: Machine Vision Using Cellphone Camera: A comparison of deep networks for classifying three challenging denominations of Indian coins
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Indian currency coins come in a variety of denominations. Off all the varieties <tex>$\unicode{x20B9}1,\unicode{x20B9}2$</tex>, and <tex>$\unicode{x20B9}5$</tex> have similar diameters. Majority of the coin styles in market circulation for denominations of <tex>$\unicode{x20B9}1$</tex> and <tex>$\unicode{x20B9}2$</tex> coins are nearly the same except numerals on its reverse side. If a coin is resting on its obverse side, the correct denomination is not distinguishable by humans. Therefore, it was hypothesized that a digital image of a coin resting on its either size could be classified into its correct denomination by training a deep neural network model. The digital images were generated by using cheap cell phone cameras. To find the most suitable deep neural network architecture, four were selected based on the preliminary analysis carried out for comparison. The results confirm that two of the four deep neural network models can classify correct denomination from either side of a coin with accuracy of 97%.

articleTitle: Detection and State Classification of Bolts Based on Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: With the increase of the training frequency of aircraft, the frequency of daily maintenance work also increases dramatically. As key connectors in aircraft, the demand for bolts also significantly increases. Hardness is an important performance index of bolts. At present, the manual inspection method cannot meet the requirement for the hardness test of the large number of the bolts. Therefore, there is an urgent need to develop an automated hardness detection system. In this paper, a bolt state detection method based on Faster R-CNN is proposed, which is an important part of an automated hardness detection system and can assist the robot grasping the bolt and placing it on the hardness tester. This method can detect bolts on the pallet and classify their states. The mean average precision (mAP) of this model used in the bolt dataset is 96.44%.

articleTitle: Bending Actuation of Ferromagnetic Soft Continuum Robot under Spatially non-uniform Magnetic Fields
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease seriously affects the health and life quality of human being in nowadays society. In this paper, a new type of ferromagnetic soft continuum robot (FSCR) is devised to realize the flexible maneuver in the blood vessel to treat cardiovascular disease. Its bending actuation performance is studied under the various distance between the robot and a spherical permanent magnet, which generates non-uniform magnetic field, and the different length-diameter ratios of the FSCR. Its bending is calculated respectively by the finite difference (FD) method and the finite element (FE) method. The simulation results of the FD method well agree with the FE method. The workspace of the FSCR is analyzed as well. Consequently, an optimal design and control scheme is established for the FSCR.

articleTitle: Development of a Hybrid Haptic Device with High Degree of Motion Decoupling
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: This paper presents a new decoupled hybrid haptic device, which can realize the motion decoupling (1) between three translation motions and three rotation motions and (2) among three translation motions. A passive gravity compensation method based on the add-of-spring principle is taken to make the device force-balanced. The experiment was conducted, which shows that the force-balancing method is effective; about 90% of shaking forces to the round can be cancelled. The experiment was conducted to show the function of this device for a potential task of rehabilitation, interaction of human users with objects in a virtual environment. The result of the experiment shows the promise of this device.

articleTitle: Face Detection-Based Depth Estimation by 2D and 3D Cameras: A Comparison
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Human-robot interaction plays a major role in designing assistive robots. A robotic arm as an assistive aid to feed the food to the physically challenged people was developed. In that, to get a target point for the end effector containing food needs to be estimated based on the detected face by the camera available on the robotic manipulator. The user can be situated anywhere between 25 cm to 100 cm away from the robotic arm's end-effector as constrained by the design. To dynamically estimate the depth to a point where a spoonful of food delivery is required, an intuitive technique based on the detected face of the user was evaluated using two 2D cameras: Open MV7, NOIR 8MP, and a 3D camera: Intel 435i. The results were calibrated with the distance obtained by the ultrasonic sensor. The 3D camera was utilized as benchmarking. For the current application, it was found that the 3D camera produced much lesser error compared to 2D cameras. It is also found that NOIR camera performs better than the Open MV7 and could be a good alternative to a 3D camera.

articleTitle: Continuous trajectory planning of a 6 DoF feeding robotic arm using a novel multi-point LSPB algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The present research paper, discusses about the novel LSPB algorithm for planning a trajectory of a multi-degree of freedom robotic arm for N numbers of intermediate points. In the current research paper, a case study of a 6 DoF indigenous economical 3D printed feeding serial manipulator is taken, which is used to feed aged patients suffering from various neurological disorders. The motive of the MP-LSPB algorithm is to provide an alternative spline trajectory planning method. The spline interpolation method is made of multiple polynomials and increases the complexity of calculations along with the computational load. Apart from this spline trajectory planning method does not provide any cushioning time at the starting and at the end of the trajectory. To overcome this problem, we have come up with a generalized MP-LSPB algorithm with lesser calculations and computational complexity, which provides smoother trajectory planning along with calculated cushioning time at the starting and at the end of the trajectory. The developed algorithm is suitable for any open source microcontroller such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, STM 32 and PIC. A homogenous trajectory planning algorithm for N numbers of intermediate points was developed, which can provide continuous angular displacement, protects mechanical joints and servo actuators from excessive vibrations, infinite acceleration and instantaneous velocity, and safely deliver the food to the patient, without wasting it. After deploying the MP-LSPB algorithm, the robot was tested successfully over 30 patients for 25 feeding cycles.

articleTitle: Multi-label Classification for Metal Defects from SEM Images using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Significant concerns have focused on how to discern different categories of metal pipes failure during routine industrial production inspection. Traditional failure analysis techniques based on scanning electron microscopy (SEM) are inefficient and rely on the expertise of experts. In order to reduce the high labor cost and accuracy associated with manual judgment, we developed a classification system using two deep learning methods, Vision Transformer (ViT) and Convolutional neural network (CNN), to examine metal pipe defects. In this study, the multi-label classification dataset containing 2,075 SEM images of four subcategories was first created. To identify the speed and effect, eight models containing three resolution were trained, validated, and tested to obtain the optimal. Finally,inference speed of these models were tested to match the real-time criteria on x86 and arm architectures computing platforms. Results showed that models based on EfficinetNet and Vision Transformer can accurately identify metal flaws on SEM images in real-time, which are similar as the results from manual judgement. In particular, EfficientNetB4 had higher accuracy of 0.969 in cracking, 0.933 in fatigue, and 0.938 in inclusion at 600x450 resolution, while ViT performed better in hole images (0.974 accuracy). EfficientNetB0 had the fastest detection speed at the same resolution, which can be used on devices with low computing performance.

articleTitle: Spiral Resonator-based Corneal Contact Lens For Intraocular Pressure Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Spiral resonator corneal contact lenses for continuous intraocular pressure (IOP) are promising devices for the diagnosis of glaucoma. Here, we design a spiral resonator corneal contact lens with high sensitivity and simplify the fabrication process. A method for manufacturing 3D spiral microfluidic channels in corneal contact lenses is proposed. The use of liquid metal improves the sensitivity of spiral resonators and does not affect the deformation of the lens. The performance of the device is evaluated using an artificial silicone eye. The sensitivity of the sensor reached 0.2557 <tex>$\text{MHz}/\upmu\mathrm{L}$</tex> and the results proved its good stability and repeatability. The results show its great potential for clinical application.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of imbalanced multi-channel data based on deep transfer learning
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The fault diagnosis is an effective method to reduce downtime and maintenance costs. However, the fault samples obtained in actual production are far less than normal samples, which leads to the fault condition of small samples is difficult to be effectively identified. To solve the problem of imbalanced samples, this paper proposes a novel fault diagnosis model, which combines the Convolutional Neural Network and transfer learning. The proposed methodology can make the fault diagnosis model be more inclined to small sample fault data. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by a real-world case study. The results show that the deep transfer learning model has excellent fault diagnosis performance in the case of sample imbalance.

articleTitle: An Objective Pain Measurement Machine Learning Model through Facial Expressions and Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The widely used technique for measuring patient pain in modern medicine is based on patients' self-reported pain. Since each human body experiences pain differently and has its own distinct pain threshold, it is very difficult for professionals to objectively evaluate a patient's level of pain based on their own description. In order for pain management treatments and prescribed therapy to be efficient and effective, a precise evaluation of pain is crucial. This study developed an objective pain measurement model based on machine learning algorithms and an open-source BioVid heat pain database. More specifically, the properties of skin conductance at various pain thresholds were examined. Electrocardiogram (ECG) and facial expression data were also assessed for performance. The study's findings demonstrate that both facial expression-based and ECG-based models can detect whether a patient is in pain. The physiological response of the subject can be utilized as a nonverbal test to gauge the patient's level of discomfort. The ECG-based model is more precise than the one based on facial expressions because we are able to gather more data with the former, therefore improving the model's accuracy, by increasing the period of the pain stimulation and the number of participants.

articleTitle: Collaborative Hand-eye Virtual Interaction Visualization Method and Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Human computer interaction is one of the core technologies in advanced scenes such as virtual reality. It plays an important role in promoting the wide application of such scenes and improving the operation efficiency and experience. At present, due to the progress of sensor and other hardware technologies, human-computer interaction ways are constantly enriched and refined, providing opportunities and laying a technical foundation for the improvement of human-computer cooperation in related fields. This paper summarizes the research progress in the three fields of virtual multi-channel interaction, virtual interactive visualization in recent years and their summary, and forms an review of hand-eye collaboration and other virtual interaction methods.

articleTitle: Research on quality improvement of bullet Assembly based on image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: A method to improve the assembly quality of cartridge primer based on image processing is proposed. In China's bullet production and testing, there is no special equipment and method for the corresponding selection and matching (hereinafter referred to as selection) after the detection of cartridge primer and cartridge. The fit between primer and cartridge is similar to that between two cylinders. Therefore, its roundness and size are detected based on image processing technology, so as to achieve optimal matching and improve the quality of assembly. This paper explains the principle of a primer shape detection mechanism, detects the image based on the edge detection algorithm of histogram equalization, and stores the primer characteristic data.

articleTitle: A High-torque Bidirectional Curl Pneumatic Artificial Muscle
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: This paper presents structure design and testing of a new high-torque Bidirectional Curl Pneumatic Artificial Muscle (BCPAM) consisting of two identical inflatable semi-elliptic cylindrical chambers in parallel and symmetric arrangement. Each chamber is enclosed by a hyperelastic silicone bladder encircled by an anisotropic elastic fabric sheath in circumference and fastened by conical fittings at two ends. The sheath is composed of Rubber-blended Polyester-knitted Fabric (RPF) with high uniaxial elasticity to allow longitudinal stretch and restrict radial expansion of the bladder, and is partially reinforced by Polyvinylchloride-coated Polyester-woven Fabric (PPF) with high in-plane strength working as a neutral limit layer for bending deformation of the BCPAM. Blocked and free bending tests show the proposed BCPAM endures high inflating pressure (400 kPa) and produces high torque output (34.1 N m) and considerable range of motion. The proposed BCPAM has potential applications in bionic and rehabilitation robots.

articleTitle: A study of the impacts of message framing and narrative visualization on sleep behavior intervention
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: This research investigated the effect of narrative visualization and message framing on health behavior change by combining the theory of planned behavior (TPB) and the protection motivation theory (PMT). Relevant hypotheses were examined to test the effect of message framing and narrative visualization in enhancing perceived threat and facilitating behavior change decisions. The effect of sleep information intervention was examined based on the interaction of message framing and narrative visualization. Using a survey of 467 college students, the study shows that negative framing information enhances the perception of response resistance better than positive framing information. On the other hand, positive framing information can enhance the perception of behavioral attitude better than negative framing information. The results provide a basis for the following information presentation in health behavior change.

articleTitle: Muscle Synergies Patterns in Post-stroke Patients
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Previous studies have reported that stroke alters the structures and recruitment patterns of muscle synergies and leads to abnormal motor performances. However, modification patterns of synergies in post-stroke patients are still unclear, which results in limited applications of muscle synergies in the clinical environment. This study extracted muscle synergy from patients and compared it with a set of reference synergies derived from healthy individuals. Averagely, both groups identified three muscle synergies. Synergy merging analysis showed that affected synergies can be generated by four types of combination patterns of reference synergies, merging, sharing, losing, and preservation. The results promote the understanding of underlying neurophysiological mechanisms applied by stroke patients and clinical applications of muscle synergies.

articleTitle: The design of tennis training platform based on the service robot
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: At present, there are several obvious pain points in the tennis training market: backward training equipment, lack of universal platform, uneven geographical distribution, and low training efficiency. In view of this situation, this paper proposes a tennis training platform based on service robot. Through the use of Internet technology and video communication technology, and through the use of service robots and ball picking robots to help students train, online and remote tennis teaching has been achieved, breaking through the limitations of space and distance, and providing a universal platform for tennis training. While improving the overall efficiency of tennis training, it also reduces the cost and price required for training.

articleTitle: On the packaging design of Agri-Tourism products based on improved AHP method
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: This This paper is to construct a systematic framework and comprehensive evaluation model for the packaging design of agri-tourism products based on the improved AHP method. Firstly, a systematic framework for the design of packaging for agri-tourism products is constructed, and a hierarchical model of the design elements is established based on the user requirements by selecting 6 criteria and 31 sub-criteria elements. Secondly, the three-scale method is used to create a judgement matrix and to derive the weights and importance ranking of the design elements. Thirdly, packaging design strategies and design solutions are generated under the guidance of sequencing. Finally the original product packaging and the generated solutions are evaluated for comparison.[1] The evaluation results shows that sensory aesthetics is the most important design element, followed by agri-tourism integration, functional attributes, and emotional needs, interactive experience and structural layout. The overall evaluation score of 3.544 for the packaging design solution generated based on the improved AHP method is higher than the original solution score of 2.331. The design example demonstrates the feasibility of improving the AHP method to effectively enhance the packaging quality of agritourism products.

articleTitle: Study on the Reliability of SemGCN in Gait Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The purpose of research is to analyze the gait parameters of figure in the video when he is not 90 degrees to the camera position through the trained SemGCN model, and analyze its reliability. Two groups of video data in the experiment are collected in the same time, meaning experimental group and reference group. In the video data of experimental group, the angle between figure and camera position is 120 degrees, while it is 90 degrees in the video data of reference group. The 2D joint point coordinate information of video data in experimental group is obtained firstly through 2D network, and then it is delivered to trained SemGCN model to regress 3D model and extract 3D joint point coordinate information, then output knee angle curve, which would be processed for filtering and smoothing by Savitzky-Golay wave filter. The video data in reference group is directly processed through Openpose algorithm, and the knee angle curve is output. Finally, the relevance of data in two groups are analyzed by adopting intraclass correlation coefficient(ICC). The result shows that the correlation of a single measurement is 0.898, meaning the data in two groups are strongly correlated. The reliability of gait parameters of figure in the video which are analyzed by using SemGCN model is good, which can be applied for the measurement of figure joint angle in video or other relevant fields.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction with Locally Preserving Projections Based on Fuzzy K-neighbor
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: In order to find the nonlinear structure existing in the high-dimensional data set, and improve recognition accuracy, a novel feature extraction method with locally preserving projections (LPP)based on fuzzy K-nearest neighbor (F-LPP) is proposed. Firstly, Euclidean distance between training samples is calculated to determine the membership function between samples. Secondly, the weight matrix S in LPP is defined according to the membership function. Finally, the optimal projection matrix V of training samples was obtained according to LPP algorithm, and the samples are mapped to a low-dimensional space. In addition, the distance of the original samples in low-dimensional space is calculated to recognize and classify the target. Experimental results on crack defect images, welding defect images and binary image database show that the proposed algorithm F-LPP not only has some advantages in dimension reduction, but also greatly improves the classification recognition rate compared with the traditional principal PCA and LPP algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Display Area of Chinese Text Boxes in the Virtual Reality Field of View
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Reading is a fundamental activity for acquiring information, whether in the real world or virtual environment. The virtual environment provides users with a text display that is different from reality, and its reading experience has always been problematic. This paper aims to explore the effect of text presentation depth on the maximum display area of the Chinese text box that users can read comfortably in a virtual environment. The experiment adopts the parameter adjustment method. The text will be randomly presented in the virtual environment at four depths (0.5 m, 2.5 m, 6 m, and 10 m). Experiment participants needed to adjust the maximum display area of the Chinese text box under the conditions of ensuring reading comfort. The research results show that the width and height of the largest text box display area will decrease with increasing text rendering depth. This research suggests that the width of the display area of the Chinese text box in the virtual environment should not exceed 20°, and the highest point of the display area in the vertical direction should preferably not be higher than eye level 5°.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on the workspace of the ejection mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Aiming at the unloading process in the small caliber ammunition assembly line, a multi degree of freedom manipulator unloading mechanism is designed. Based on the Monte Carlo method, the coordinates of the unloading mechanism are set, and the workspace of the end effector is simulated and analyzed. Under the determined parameter conditions, the position feasible region of the mechanism is obtained by numerical calculation, which is verified with the limit position calculated by the graphical method, Finally, the UG simulation module is used to simulate the kinematics of the unloading mechanism, which further confirms that the unloading mechanism can meet the design requirements under various complex motion conditions.

Author Keywords: unloading mechanism of small caliber ammunition

articleTitle: Airflow Sensing, Pre-Bending Soft Pneumatic Gripper and Its Characterization
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Almost all soft pneumatic grippers rely on electronic sensors for closed-loop control. This paper describes an airflow sensing block to obtain it, which is based on the back pressure characteristics of airflow. This block can generate high vacuum at low supply pressure and feedback a continuous signal from negative to positive pressure to drive the soft actuator. The systematic experiments were conducted to investigate the back pressure characteristics of the airflow sensing block. What's more, we developed a pre-bending actuator to improve the response time of the gripper. A mathematic model of the actuator was also established. By fitting the data of the back pressure characteristics, we derived the static model of the gripper that was built by mounting the sensing block to a soft actuator. Finally, we experimentally demonstrated the self-feedback dynamic grasping of the target object within 0.107s.

articleTitle: Design of Elastic Joints for a Bionic Parallel Chewing Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Chewing robots have promising applications in the fields of dentistry, food safety, and prosthetic restoration. The temporomandibular joint structure is an important factor affecting the performance of the chewing robot. The bionic design of human temporomandibular joints plays an important part in reproducing the complex movements of the human masticatory system faithfully. In order to improve the bionic performance of the chewing robot, this paper presents a new elastic constrained joints using elastic elements. The structure uses springs to simulate the visco-elastic properties of the temporomandibular joint disc. With the built-in sensors, the internal forces of the temporomandibular joint can be measured. The trajectory of the bionic chewing robot is planed based on inverse kinematics. Finally, the bilateral condylar forces are measured under different occlusal forces. The results show that this design of elastic constrained joints further improves the robot bionic performance and can effectively detect the forces on the joints of the chewing robot.

articleTitle: Online, Real-time and Robust Detection and Localization of Foreign Objects on Paper Surface using Machine Vision and Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: To serve the needs of surface inspection during the high-speed paper production process, this paper focuses on the design of the machine vision system and the development of associated algorithms for computationally efficient robust detection and localization of unwanted foreign objects. We address the practical challenges during the design of the architecture of an overall system that consists of cameras, illumination arrangement, and computing platforms. For the processing of images, we use machine vision for feature extraction followed by clustering for the quantification and localization of defects. We also conduct simulations and analyse detection error and localization error to evaluate the performance of the proposed system and algorithms. The proposed system has been deployed in the industry for surface inspection.

articleTitle: Research on UWB-Based Data Fusion Positioning Method
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: It is difficult for a single sensor to achieve good positioning accuracy due to the complex environment of the indoor positioning. In order to improve the accuracy and stability of the positioning system, UWB and other sensors can be used for fusion positioning which can combine the advantages of different positioning methods. Based on the UWB multi-systems fusion positioning experimental platform, this paper analyze the effect of multi-sensor data fusion positioning by comparing and analyzing UWB positioning, encoder and attitude sensor positioning and data fusion positioning of the three sensors. The result shows that the data fusion positioning method designed in this paper can improve the overall positioning accuracy and stability, and can avoid the positioning failure caused by the loss of UWB positioning signal.

articleTitle: Performance of Actuators for Facial Robot: A Comparison Study Between Electric Motor and Dielectric Elastomer Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Realistic eye motion of humanoid robots can significantly improve the efficiency of information exchange between humans and robots. Up to now, humanoid robots are mainly driven by motors. On the other hand, with mechanisms and performances close to the natural muscle, the dielectric elastomer actuator (DEA) has been emerging technology for actuating the humanoid robot. While both actuators can drive the eyeball to achieve human-like movement, little work has been done on comparing their performance quantitatively. To compare these two actuators utilized in humanoid robots, we made artificial eyes with motors and DEA respectively. In this paper, we compare the artificial eyes of these two actuators in terms of structure, working principle, equipment, motion response, efficiency and drive mode, etc. The result describes the characteristics of the two actuators and provides a basis for selection for various application scenarios.

articleTitle: A Virtual Assistant System for the Requirements Elicitation and Initial Simulation Model Variant Generation of Modular Industrial Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Errors during the commissioning of machines and plants are costly and time-consuming. Costs increase the later an error is discovered in the development process. The earliest occurring errors can already result from insufficient coordination with the customer. This paper presents the ongoing research on a virtual assistance system designed to bridge the gap between the early requirements phase and the virtual commissioning of modular plants by creating interfaces for customers allowing them to outline their project, validate it by themselves and be actively integrated in the process of the virtual plant creation.

articleTitle: Optimal Feedback Linearization Control for a Bioinspired Soft Pneumatic Contractive Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The soft pneumatic actuation is considered one of the most practical actuation systems in bioinspired applications, where the supplied air inflates expandable channels embedded in soft materials and causes desired movements. As the number of soft actuation applications increases, the control of soft pneumatic actuators becomes more important. This paper discusses the design and implementation of the feedback linearization control for a soft ring actuator called RiSPA. RiSPA is a bellows-driven, elastomer-based actuator that was developed to reproduce motility functions of the lower part of the stomach for a gastric simulator. The dynamics model for the RiSPA is highly nonlinear and time-varying. By applying feedback linearization, the RiSPA's dynamic model is converted into a linear time-invariant (LTI) system. Then, the linear quadratic regulator (as a linear optimal controller) is designed and applied on the new LTI model. The numerical simulation results show that the regulation performance is successfully conducted on the RiSPA model, and all the state variables have reached their desired values.

articleTitle: Research on User Transparency Perception Based on Mixed Reality
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The user's visual perception in mixed reality (MR) includes the combination of the real physical environment and virtual objects rendered in an optical see-through head mounted display (OST-HMD), so the presentation of MR rendering objects will be affected by the light from the real world; thus, rendering effect deviates from the original design intent. This paper focuses on the user's perception of transparency in mixed reality and the impact of ambient illumination on the perception of transparency in mixed reality. We conducted a psychophysical experimental study and recruited 20 participants to recognize the transparency of virtual objects under two kinds of ambient illumination via Microsoft HoloLens and select the corresponding value in the slider. Our analysis shows that the transparency of virtual objects will be underestimated when the ambient illumination is high. Additionally, the experiments also found that as the magnitude of transparency increases, the perception of transparency will be underestimated. This study can provide a reference for the design of MR interface transparency coding.

articleTitle: Design of Temperature Control System of Insufflator Based on Fuzzy and PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Laparoscopic surgery is a widely used minimally invasive surgery. Although using warm carbon dioxide to establish pneumoperitoneum has been demonstrated beneficial, building a high-precision and fast-response temperature control system is difficult to achieve. To this end, we propose a temperature control system for insufflator with hot and cold flow mixed. Firstly, we design the pipeline structure of the system, and the circuit hardware considering the selected components. Then, two stages, including preheating and delivery stage, are developed to improve the heating efficiency of the system, which are controlled by fuzzy logic and PID algorithm, respectively. Besides, we construct the simulation model to investigate the transfer characteristics of the heating system. Finally, a prototype of the system is developed, and experiments are performed to validate its effectiveness. The proposed system provides a feasible scheme of carbon dioxide heating for building pneumoperitoneum.

articleTitle: Color Matching Evaluation of Industrial Digital Twin Interface Based on Grey Fixed Weight Clustering Method
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Among many similar types of interfaces, appropriate color scheme can make a significant contribution to the digital presentation of information in the physical world. Therefore, using reasonable methods to evaluate and analyze a variety of interface color combinations can be a significant auxiliary role in the design of interface. This study establishes the user interface color matching evaluation system with hierarchical analysis and grey clustering theory. Based on the characteristics of digital twin interface, two kinds of subjective indexes, namely Aesthetic perception and Behavioral experience. Based on the characteristics of digital twin interface in the industrial field, this study analyzes and summarizes two categories of subjective indicators, namely Aesthetic perception and Behavioral experience. Analytical hierarchy process is used to obtain index weights, and the color scheme is extracted by k-means algorithm and applied to the evaluation experimental interface. Based on the grey clustering theory, the experimental samples were clustered and analyzed to construct a user interface color scheme evaluation system. This paper used the VMC850 digital twin interface as a case study to provide a scientific basis for the interface evaluation method.

articleTitle: Spare Parts Inventory Optimization using Multi-Agent Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Spare parts inventory optimization is an classic research content in Operation Research. Existing parameterized inventory policies can't be dynamically controlled with inventory level and neural network-based algorithms are time-consuming. Therefore, a multi-agent hierarchical reinforcement learning algorithm considering reward allocation is utilized to solve multi-level spare parts inventory problem in the paper. The numerical examples validate the performance of the proposed algorithm and conclusion shows that it has greater efficiency on calculation time while dynamically controlling inventory level.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Digital Twin Interface Based on Aesthetics
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The human-computer interaction interface is essential in the digital twin interaction system. A reasonably designed and effective complex interface can improve the user's interface information perception, in which interface evaluation plays a central role in the complex information interface. This article takes the digital twin interface as a case study to evaluate the aesthetics of its interface layout. Firstly, the paper's research significance and evaluation scheme are presented. Secondly, each design structure is analyzed and evaluated by applying the interface aesthetics evaluation criteria. Finally, the results are compared and verified with the subjective evaluation results. The experiment results help designers to choose more efficient interface design solutions with higher aesthetic value in practice and provide some reference value for other interface studies.

articleTitle: A Kinematic Method for Workpiece Transfer in Virtual Commissioning
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The real time workpiece transfer simulation is important in the virtual commissioning application. However, most solutions to the workpiece transfer problem are based on the multi-body dynamic mechanism, which needs to solve complex differential equations and is time consuming. This study proposes a method based on kinematic mechanism. In this method, the workpiece was attached to different moving parts at different stages. The attachment status was judged by the distance between predefined contact surfaces. The movement of a workpiece is the superimposition of the movement of the attached part at different stages. The results of virtual commissioning of a stacker device show that this method is efficient and stable, and can meet real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Design of Human-Machine Cooperative Control Algorithm for Lower Extremity Exoskeleton
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: In this paper, a human-machine collaborative control algorithm is designed to address the problems of the lower extremity exoskeleton such as poor adaptability to the external environment. The trajectory following control algorithms are designed based on the retest lasso drive system, and the performance of each trajectory following controller is compared. The experimental results show that the sliding mode control algorithm based on fuzzy gain has a better trajectory following effect compared to sliding mode control algorithm.

articleTitle: Exploration of driverless electric vehicle interaction interface design based on human-computer system
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Through the anthropomorphic design of the human-computer interaction interface outside the driverless electric vehicle and the use of multi-channel information expression inside the vehicle, the user can obtain the vehicle driving information more accurately and efficiently, better communicate with the driverless vehicle and effectively enhance the trust of the driverless vehicle. Using literature research as a means to summarise the main points of the design of the human-computer interaction interface outside the car, the design points are presented in an anthropomorphic way. The design elements are presented in an anthropomorphic way in the design of the interaction interface, and then the design elements are verified to be reasonable by means of a design test of the human-machine interaction interface outside the vehicle. The reasons for low trust in unmanned driving are analysed in the vehicle, and different multi-channel combinations are briefly described for different driving scenarios, and audio-visual and tactile multi-channels are selected as test objects to verify the effectiveness of the multi-channel combination in improving trust in driving. The combination of multiple channels in the vehicle can be used to express a reasonable signal strength for a specific driving scenario, which can effectively improve the trust level of unmanned driving.

articleTitle: The biological vesicle elastohydrodynamic model of deformation of red blood cells in permeable microvessels
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to investigate the deformation of red blood cells (RBCs) in permeable microvessels by establishing the biological vesicle elastohydrodynamic model. Unlike the current deformation models of red blood cells (such as elastic shell model and liquid-drop model), a red blood cell is regarded as an axisymmetric biological vesicle in the liquid crystal state in this study. Elastohydrodynamic theory and the Starling assumptions are applied to explain the flow of suspending plasma in gaps between red blood cells and vessel walls and the coupling effect between plasma pressure and tissue fluid pressure in permeable microvessels. In addition, the calculation dealing with deformation shapes derives from the shooting method, in which the deformation shape of red blood cells is approximately a vesicle of stomatocyte in microvessels. Furthermore, the deformation quantity of red blood cells increases with increasing velocity of red blood cells or decreasing diameter of vessels. As for the comparisons, the biomembrane model possesses a smaller hematocrit ratio and a greater relative apparent viscosity calculated than the thin shell model at the same velocity of red blood cells; Fahraeus-Lindqvist effect predicted in the biomembrane model is more obvious than the thin shell model in a range of (0-8μm) vessel diameters.

articleTitle: Exploring non-destructive mechanical characterisation of hydrogels using hyperspectral imaging and machine vision
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Hydrogel polymer networks are non-covalently crosslinked soft materials that exhibit unique mechanical and excellent bio-characteristics such as adapting to environmental forces and strengthening to the conditions they experience. Quantifying these characteristics are important for their usage in multitude of applications especially where new formulations or composites of hydrogels being prepared such as for 3D printing. Often such characteristics are quantified using destruc-tive methods and/or using complex mathematical models, which can destroy samples, are limiting and time-consuming. Herein, we describe non-destructive hyperspectral imaging (HSI) based machine vision approach that enable faster characterisation of hydrogel's mechanical properties. Several measurements of hydrogel samples were collected using HSI to develop a database used to train a Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) based learning model. From the confusion matrix results, we observed the >90% accuracy, which we think can provide relatively good performance compared to other traditional methods. We conclude that HSI with machine vision could simplify the measurement procedure, allowing for a more straightforward characterisation of hydrogel samples, is fast and reproducible to provide serve as both an in-process and a quality control method.

articleTitle: An AGV Appearance Optimization Design Based On Humanized Design Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: As a modern intelligent industrial product, AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) is becoming more and more important in the context of intelligent manufacturing. In order to enhance the market competitiveness of AGVs, it is necessary to improve its industrial design level under the guidance of humanized design theory. The practice of safety, ergonomics, shape design and color design in the field of AGV design are analyzed based on the theory of humanized design in this paper. Finally, based on the humanized design theory, this paper optimizes the appearance design of a heavy-load AGV.

articleTitle: Analysis of Differentiated User Needs of Induction Cooktop Operational Interface Based on Eye-Tracking Experiment
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: In China's small appliance market, the appearance designs of products have been highly homogenized, leading to fierce competition. Designing strategies that can promote product differentiation have been widely embraced for their capability in satisfying more diverse market needs. Taking portable induction cooktop as an example, this study investigates the differentiated demands of users in two age groups (20–35 and 55–70) through eye-tracking experiments on the operational interface of selected products available in both online and offline markets. Quantitative analysis is conducted based on results collected from hotspot and cluster images produced by the experiment. The goal is to inspire creative ideas for more differentiated designs in small appliances.

articleTitle: 3D Printing using steerable needles
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Needle-based 3D printers are commonly used to 3D print bio-polymers to form complex geometries with specific physical characteristics and / or behavior (e.g., shape changing, etc.). With the recent advancements in bio-polymers for 3D / 4D printing applications, a need has arisen to 3D print or deposit these polymers for polymerization in various and previously un-imagined ways. This work explores the concept of using long, steerable needles to 3D print bio-polymers with certain characteristics inside of penetrable bodies that require a 3D structure in specific and previously hard to reach locations. We present a motion planning approach based on literature which can develop a path depending on a start position and desired end position within an input body. Several control measures are defined which enables an electro-mechanical system to perform several motions to achieve the aforementioned path. Furthermore, a system is presented which is designed specifically to “deposit” and then polymerize materials within a body after achieving the desired path and end position within satisfactory tolerance. This paper describes the potential of steerable needles for the application of 3D printing in penetrable bodies.

articleTitle: Study on Acoustic-Elastic Effect in Aramid Fiber Reinforced Epoxy Composites for High Voltage Insulation Pull Rod
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Aramid reinforced epoxy resin composites are widely used in the molding of insulation parts of power equipment. Factors such as impregnation, curing process or external force during production or processing may cause residual stress in the aramid reinforced epoxy composite insulation. The tensile or compressive load under handover or operation conditions will be superimposed with the residual stress. When the stress exceeds the tolerance limit of the insulation material, micro cracks and other damages will be formed, which will lead to mechanical failure or insulation breakdown. In this paper, the ultrasonic longitudinal wave reflection method is used to test the standard specimen of aramid fiber reinforced epoxy resin. The relationship between the vertical compressive stress on the specimen and the ultrasonic longitudinal wave velocity in the specimen is studied, the acoustic elastic effect is verified, and the longitudinal wave acoustic elastic coefficient of the standard specimen whose ultrasonic propagation direction is perpendicular to the stress is calculated.

articleTitle: Preliminary assessment of blood effect on the Raman spectra of breast tumor tissue
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The distinguishment between the tumor tissue and healthy tissue is a key step during tumor surgery. Raman spectroscopy is a promising tool to achieve this function. However, the blood around the tissue poses challenges in determining the boundary of the tumor tissue. In this paper, the blood effect on the Raman spectral of breast tumor tissue is investigated. The Raman spectra of the tumor tissue and its adjacent healthy tissue were collected. Then, principal component analysis (PCA) is adopted to reduce data dimension, and support vector machine (SVM) is used to classify tumors and healthy tissue. The blood effect index (BEI) is proposed to evaluate the effect of blood on the Raman spectra of breast tumor tissue and healthy tissue. The effect of blood on the Raman spectra is analyzed. It demonstrated that the existence of blood could affect the intensity of the Raman peaks. The affected peak was selected and processed with the recursive least-squares (RLS) algorithm in order to reduce the effect of blood on the spectra.

articleTitle: Deep Residual Shrinkage Networks for Adaptive Classification of EEG Error-Related Potentials
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Error related potentials(ErrPs) can reflect the brain's response to errors. In recent years, it has been used to study the neural mechanisms of human cognition, such as error detection and conflict monitoring. Although deep learning methods are commonly used for EEG analysis, they are rarely used for adaptive classification of ErrPs. In this paper, the deep residual shrinkage networks(DRSN) based on ResNets is used for adaptive classification of ErrPs signals. DRSN aims to improve the feature learning ability of the model under high noise or complex background. Its main innovation is introducing residual shrinkage units into ResNets, which integrates a soft threshold into ResNets as a nonlinear conversion layer, and automatically determines the threshold so as to reduce the influence of noise in EEG signals. Therefore, DRSN can also save more preprocessing steps related to denoising and simplify the signal processing of ErrPs. In addition, DRSN also introduces focal loss to reduce the impact of sample imbalance on classification results. The public dataset BNCI2020 dataset22 is used to verify the adaptive classification performance of DRSN. The classification results of DRSN greatly outperforms other existing adaptive classification methods. In the case of completely blind adaptive classification, the average classification accuracy of DRSN reaches 73.08%. Under the condition that the original data is just preprocessed by common average reference(CAR), the average adaptive classification accuracy of DRSN reaches 79.65%, which is about 60% higher than other adaptive classification methods using CAR, and in this case, DRSN significantly increase the classification accuracy by about 7% of subjects with weak ErrPs quality. In addition, compared with ResNets, DRSN is less time-consuming after introducing the residual shrinkage module for improving the efficiency.

articleTitle: Concept for a Reinforcement Learning Approach to Navigate Catheters Through Blood Vessels
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Minimally invasive procedures are state of the art in the treatment of cardiovascular diseases. The navigation of catheters is a challenging task for cardiologists. Therefore, new robot-based techniques are emerging to assist them. However, the task of navigation remains with the cardiologist. In this paper, a concept is presented for automating the navigation of a catheter using reinforcement learning on a simulation. The results show that the agent is able to learn how to navigate to a defined target point, which allows the study of more realistic scenarios.

articleTitle: Surface Defect Detection of Cable Based on Improved YOLO V3
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: When using yolov3 identification technology to detect the defects on the cable surface of cable-stayed bridge, although it has also achieved good detection results, there is a problem that the detection speed of the network is slow, and the detection accuracy of cracking is much lower than that of other kinds of defects. To solve these problems, this paper improves the running speed and detection accuracy, merges the BN layer and convolution layer, and embeds the CBAM attention mechanism into the yolov3 network. The experimental results show that the average accuracy map of crack detection is increased to 82.3%, and the running speed is increased to 51.4 frames per second, which meets the requirements of precision and speed of cable surface defect detection.

articleTitle: Orchard Yield Estimation using Multi-angle Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: This paper presents current methods used for orchard yield estimation, and a new method for adapting these methods regarding orchard yield estimation for kiwifruit. We discuss proven solutions for similar problems and elaborate on how those solutions have been integrated, to have the best possible method to estimate kiwifruit orchard yields. The proposed solution uses object detection via a convolutional neural network (CNN) to identify and count kiwifruit, with images being obtained by a hexa-drone unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flown under kiwifruit orchards, providing the smoothest camera capture to increase accuracy of object detection throughout the orchard. This proposed method is expected to allow farmers to know an estimate of current kiwifruit production, as well as the detection of over or under performing orchard sections.

articleTitle: Co-Design: Sustainable Innovation Power of Landscape Co-Creation in the Context of Third Class Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Artificial intelligence will become a core element of smart cities in the future, and the updated iterations of digital and technology will significantly promote upgrading all aspects of value, choice, and creation. When artificial intelligence is sweeping the design field, the coverage of design engagement ability has expanded from a single audience to various areas. The value of sensory visualization and co-creation in interaction has increased. This paper summarizes the many changes that AI has brought to landscape design in a linear time sequence and explores the co-design capabilities of the third type of intelligence under the co-evolution of humans and AI from multiple dimensions. It also discusses landscape co-creation's sustainable and innovative power in environmental art, interactive installation, and digital drawing.

articleTitle: Indian Commercial Truck License Plate Detection and Recognition for Weighbridge Automation
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Detection and recognition of a licence plate is important when automating weighbridge services. While many large databases are available for Latin and Chinese alphanumeric license plates, data for Indian License Plates is inadequate. In particular, databases of Indian commercial truck license plates are inadequate, despite the fact that commercial vehicle license plate recognition plays a profound role in terms of logistics management and weighbridge automation. Moreover, models to recognise license plates are not effectively able to generalise to such data due to its challenging nature, and due to the abundant frequency of handwritten license plates, leading to usage of diverse font styles. Thus, a database and effective models to recognise and detect such license plates are crucial. This paper provides a database on commercial truck license plates, and using state-of-the-art models in real-time Object Detection: You Only Look Once Version 7, and Scene Text Recognition: Permuted Autoregressive Sequence Models, our method outperforms the other cited references where the maximum accuracy obtained was less than 90%, while we have achieved 95.82% accuracy in our algorithm implementation on the presented challenging license plate dataset.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Seed Sowing Performance of a UAV Supported Pneumatic Planting System
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: In agricultural technology, seed sowing involves manual processes such as broadcasting, and, more popularly, mechanical operations, including tractor-drawn drill and planter machinery. However, limitations of the above methods include the initial and running cost of equipment, the requirement for significant human resources, as well as damage incurred due to transplanting. This research paper addresses the performance of a UAV-mounted pneumatic seed planting system for use in low-cost farming. In comparison to gravity-fed seeding methods used in aerial and UAV applications, pneumatic technology offers a higher success rate due to uniform seed deployments and mitigation of seed wastage. Seedpod biotechnology targets reforestation and afforestation due to its drought endurance and predation protection. The use of pneumatically-dispensed seedpods in agriculture is investigated with respect to achievable planting depths and spacing. The thrust mechanism for deployment of seedpods and their deceleration before impact with soil media was numerically evaluated. The impact of various soil s-values on achievable terminal depths were also numerically assessed. Terminal depths of up to 6cm were observed from the pneumatic system's pressure range of 300psi to 750psi.

articleTitle: Design of real-time image processing system of medical high-definition electronic endoscope based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Medical high-definition electronic endoscopes have high requirements on real-time performance and video quality. Compared with software-based image algorithms, the algorithms based on field programmable gate array (FPGA) have higher real-time performance, but are more difficult to implement. Referring to the working requirements of the medical high-definition electronic endoscope image processing system, an experimental platform for the real-time image processing system based on FPGA is designed in this paper. And the FPGA implementation of lens shading correction, white balance and gamma correction is studied in this system. The hardware consumption is effectively reduced by improving the relevant algorithm equations. After these three kinds of processing, the output image quality is obviously improved, and high-definition output is realized. At the same time, the total time delay of three kinds of image signal processing based on FPGA is within 16 working clock cycles, which can well meet the real-time working requirements of endoscope. The design of this system has certain reference for the research of medical high-definition electronic real-time image processing system. The realization of the three algorithms also enriches the research of FPGA-based image processing algorithms.

articleTitle: Extensible Bidirectional Bending Soft Robot for Hand Functional Rehabilitation Training
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Soft robot has the advantage of good flexibility, high safety and portability in hand function rehabilitation training. In order to solve problems such as poor fit between soft robot and human hand, insufficient DOF and low driving force, this paper designed a soft robot with bidirectional bending module and elongation module, which can realize independent or coupled motion of multiple DOF. Using the FEM analysis method, soft driver model was established and a variety of flexible materials were used to ensure that it can provide sufficient driving force. The sensor was used to track the bending characteristics. Experiment results have verified that soft robot can complete grip and gesture training, and meet the training requirements of patients at different rehabilitation stages. The fingertip force can reach 5.1N and play an auxiliary role in the daily hand rehabilitation training of patients.

articleTitle: Projection Distance-based Dynamic Objects Removal for 3D Point Cloud Map Construction
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: 3D point cloud maps are critical for self-driving cars and robots to perform navigation and localization in multiple changing environments. However, since lidar scans used for map construction may contain dynamic objects which leave unwanted traces in the maps. These traces will inevitably deteriorate the quality of maps and affect both localization and navigation accuracy. State-of-the-art works suffer from the ambiguity caused by noisy motion or incidence angle to some extent. To tackle this problem, we propose a robust method to keep only static points and remove dynamic ones in map by comparing the discrepancies between single scan against registered noisy map. This method takes advantage of the fact that light travels in a straight line and can not penetrate most objects. Accordingly, we present a two-stage projection distance-based strategy to discriminate static/dynamic points. Furthermore, we also propose a novel way of generating artificial background endpoints to overcome the issue when there are not sufficient static points observed behind the dynamic points. Experimental evaluations are conducted on the SemanticKITTI dataset to indicate that the our method is robust and reliable against other methods.

articleTitle: Optimized Two-Axis Inertial Stabilization Platform Design for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Integration
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The onset of the fourth industrial revolution, Industry 4.0, is characterized by the Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), cyber-physical systems, and the automation of processes to produce smart factories. Included in Industry 4.0, falling under the “intelligent devices” category, are Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) or drones. Industry 4.0 has highlighted the potential of UAVs to perform tasks previously performed by humans or other, more cumbersome production systems, in a more economical and efficient way. This potential function of UAVs can be extrapolated into the disaster management scenario, where the UAV will be used for the transportation of medical supplies, and essential items such as food, water, vaccines, and blood samples This paper details the research and design of an Inertial Stabilization Platform (ISP) which is compatible with the DJI Matrice 300 UAV for disaster management applications. The design was required to be lightweight but durable, and capable of repetitively stabilizing the load being transported by the UAV. Key features of the design included the use of standard off-the-shelf batteries, actuators, a microcontroller, and an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU). The final design assembly features an Arduino Nano microcontroller, an Adafruit BNO055 Inertial Measurement Unit, two DSSERVO 35kg servo motors, and two 7.4V lithiumion batteries to power the device, one with a 1200mAh capacity, and one with a 2600mAh capacity. The final payload capacity, subject to increase due to further mass reductions, is 1658.94 grams.

articleTitle: RGB-D SLAM Using Scene Flow in Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Visual simultaneous location and mapping (SLAM) plays an important role in navigation and augmented reality (AR). Static environment is a common assumption for traditional visual SLAM to work properly, which limits the widespread usage of visual SLAM in real world scenes. The dynamic objects can impair the accuracy of camera pose estimation and the quality of point cloud map. In this paper, a novel motion removal visual system built on ORB-SLAM2 is proposed. The algorithm extracts pixel-level dynamic objects in RGB-D image sequences with scene flow method we present. The scene flow model uses dense optical flow and depth data to estimate undefined moving objects without needing prior information and only static keypoints are used for tracking. In order to verify the performance of the SLAM system, it is evaluated on public TUM RGB-D datasets and the results demonstrate that our approach improves the tracking accuracy and work robustly in both highly and lowly dynamic scenes.

articleTitle: Marker-less Motion Capture Technology Based on Binocular Stereo Vision and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Among the current human pose estimation methods, the more mature one is the two-dimensional (2D) human pose estimation method. However, the 2D information is difficult to reflect the real posture of the human body in space, and the three-dimensional (3D) estimation algorithm is imperfect and has poor accuracy. In this paper, based on the fusion of binocular stereo vision and convolutional neural network (CNN), a new method of 3D human pose estimation was carried out. In order to verify the accuracy of this method, we used the method in this paper and Microsoft Kinect V2 to capture action images to reconstruct the 3D pose of the human body. The results showed that within the working distance of 4450-4700mm, the minimum root mean square error (RMSE), the minimum mean absolute error (MAE) and the minimum mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of the action performed by the testers could reach 20.469, 16.408 and 4.508. The length accuracy of human joints restored by this method was higher than that of Kinect V2, and the restoration of human actions in 3D space was higher.
