It can be concluded from the experimental results that the proposed method might have the ability to reduce the cost and limitation of current human motion capture, and may be applied in the fields of stroke patient rehabilitation and community rehabilitation in the future.

articleTitle: Chip Surface Defect Recognition based on Improved Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: The surface defects on integrated circuit chips are small and slender, and there exist low accuracy and difficulty in feature extraction and classification using networks models for defect recognition. Aiming at the recognition of five categories of defects on chip surfaces, an improved Faster R-CNN (Faster Region-based Convolutional Neural Network) deep learning network is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the sample data is enhanced by a combination of traditional image data augmentation and improved DCGAN (Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network) to ensure the effectiveness of the model training process. Meanwhile, to improve the recognition accuracy of the model, the ResNet50 network is introduced into the backbone network to replace the original VGG16 (GG-Very-Deep-16 CNN) network in Faster R-CNN. The experimental results show that the average accuracy and speed of the chip surface defect recognition using the proposed method are 94.92% and 27 FPS, respectively. Compared with the YOLO-v4 (You Only Look Once v4) algorithm and the original Faster R-CNN algorithm, it can better meet the accuracy and speed requirements of actual chip surface defect recognition.

articleTitle: Visual inspection system for CNC turning tool wear based on transfer learning
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: A set of CNC turning tool wear detection system is designed in this study, aiming at the tool wear problem in the manufacturing process. In this study, the overall scheme of the on-machine image acquisition system for the rake and flank faces of turning tools based on machine vision is designed, and a tool flank wear detection method based on deep learning is proposed to achieve the classification of tool flank wear status and the purpose of identifying the wear area, which improves the precision and efficiency of CNC turning.

articleTitle: Recursive parallelotope set-membership estimation algorithm in nonlinear system
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: In this paper, a novel Recursive Parallelotope Set-Membership Estimation Algorithm for discrete nonlinear system is proposed, which can carry out highly accurate state estimation. The wrapping effect is significant in the prediction process, which lowers the accuracy of the state estimation, and the iteration of existing methods cannot converge in the case of a single observation failure. This is the driving force behind the development of the Recursive Parallelotope Set-Membership Estimation Algorithm. To account for this issue, multiple measurements are introduced in this paper to update the guaranteed state in each iteration, which can eliminate more redundant information and avoid estimation errors caused by the loss of measurements. Then, a covalent separation method is proposed to reduce the wrapping effect, and build the parallelotope set's tight enclosure in nonlinear system. Furthermore, the state set is also updated using a novel parallelotope intersection approach. The suggested method's use and efficiency in terms of maximum and average estimation accuracy are attested by simulation outputs.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life prediction of rolling bearing based on ensemble learning
publicationTitle: 2022 28th International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP)
abstract: Rolling bearing is a critical component in rotation machines, and its health status plays a vital role in the normal running of the entire machine. It is beneficial to maintain and avoid some unexpected breakdowns for the machine in the operation process by predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) of the bearing. Therefore, an ensemble learning method is proposed to predict the RUL of the bearing, and three deep learning, namely BiGRU-Attention, TCN-Decoder and modified transformer models, are weighted average in the ensemble learning method. The IEEE PHM 2012 Data datasets are taken as an experiment to predict the RUL of the deep groove ball bearing to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Results indicate that the proposed ensemble learning method has good prediction effectiveness on RUL of rolling bearing.
